final_text:
Lindenmoor used 2,151,400 cubic metres, or 2,151,400,000 litres, in 2025. Dividing by 29,051 residents and 365 days gives 202.9 litres per resident per day.

Kelmarsh used 1,739 megalitres, or 1,739,000,000 litres. Dividing by 24,117 residents and 365 days gives 197.5 litres per resident per day.

The difference is 5.4 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.4
